title: Convergence of the self-dual abelian Higgs gradient flow
summary: Given an initial data configuration $(A^{\mathrm{in}}, φ^{\mathrm{in}})$ on $\mathbb R^2$ such that the self-dual abelian Higgs energy is near the minimum energy within its topological class, we prove that its evolution under the self-dual abelian Higgs gradient flow in temporal gauge converges exponentially as $t \to \infty$ with respect to the $(H^1 \times L^2)$-metric to a minimiser of the energy.
